public.title: Odd Even Linked List
public.description: values encodes a singly linked list in head-to-tail order. Return nodes at odd positions first, followed by nodes at even positions, preserving order within each group. Positions start at 1; parity refers to position rather than value. There are 0 to 1000 integers from -10000 to 10000.
hints: Separate alternating positions while preserving their relative order.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Stable selection of zero-based even indices followed by odd indices implements one-based odd-even grouping. O(n) time and output space.
